APP IDENTITY & OVERLAP RECONCILIATION — v1.1 Owner: Lucas Buzek

ENGLISH

GOAL Reconcile EDEN/AppDev names and overlap before expanding the
registry.

TEST FOR EVERY CANDIDATE 1. What TYPE is it? 2. What authoritative
domain/state does it uniquely own? 3. Which existing identities overlap?
4. Which identity owns truth and which consumes/displays/analyses it? 5.
Is standalone value meaningful? 6. Is it actually a Workspace, Helper,
Agent, Module, Capability, Provider, Product, Instance/Connection or
representation? 7. Is it a legacy/superseded identity? 8. What explicit
handoff contracts connect it to siblings? 9. What can it do with NO AI?
10. Which capabilities may use TINY/local/LAN/API/hybrid providers?

CANONICAL RELATIONSHIPS parent module_of subordinate_of
capability_provider_for invoked_by available_to depends_on
integrates_with representation_of supersedes superseded_by
legacy_aliases

RECONCILIATION RECORD CANONICAL ID NAME TYPE PURPOSE AUTHORITATIVE STATE
OWNS DOES NOT OWN OVERLAPS WITH HANDOFF CONTRACTS STANDALONE / EMBEDDED
NO_AI_CORE TINY CAPABILITIES LOCAL AI LAN AI EXTERNAL API
HYBRID/FALLBACK PRIVACY STATUS = CURRENT | MERGE-CANDIDATE | RECLASSIFY
| SUPERSEDED | UNRESOLVED PROVENANCE CONFIDENCE

BOUNDARY PRINCIPLE A NEW APP MUST EARN ITS BOUNDARY. A different model,
provider, UI, package, prompt or implementation does not by itself
create a new App.

KNOWN EXAMPLE UIbasic is legacy/provenance and is superseded by LCAS. Do
not keep both as competing current shared frameworks.

SLOVENSKY

CIEĽ Najprv zosúladiť názvy a prekryvy EDEN/AppDev, až potom rozširovať
register.

PRE KAŽDÉHO KANDIDÁTA Urči TYPE, autoritatívnu doménu/stav, prekryvy,
vlastníka pravdy, standalone hodnotu, či nejde skôr o
Workspace/Helper/Module/Capability/Provider/Product, legacy stav,
handoff kontrakty a možnosti NO-AI/TINY/LOCAL/LAN/API/HYBRID.

ZÁZNAM Canonical ID; názov; typ; účel; autoritatívny stav; vlastní;
nevlastní; prekryvy; handoff; standalone/embedded; NO_AI_CORE; TINY;
local AI; LAN AI; external API; hybrid/fallback; privacy; status;
provenance; confidence.

PRINCÍP NOVÁ APP SI MUSÍ ZASLÚŽIŤ VLASTNÚ HRANICU. Iný model, provider,
UI, balík, prompt alebo implementácia sám osebe nevytvára novú App.

UIbasic je legacy/provenance a bol nahradený LCAS.
